metadata.title: Await Reviewer Response
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Pause-and-resume checkpoint after fixing and replying to PR comments. The process pauses here until the user resumes it — either because the reviewer has left new comments (loop back to fetch) or because the PR is approved/clean (exit to continuous improvement). Handles the asynchronous nature of code review where reviewers respond hours or days later.

output.description: User decision: loop back for another iteration or exit the fix cycle

prerequisites: Replies posted in previous step (replies.posted available in memory)
This step has approvalRequired: true in the template
specificActions: Follow the substeps below in sequence
Workflow: summarize iteration → present decision checkpoint → record user decision
This is a PAUSE point — the process stops here and waits for the user to resume
The user resumes when the reviewer has responded (hours/days later)
Present two clear options: loop back for new comments, or exit because PR is clean
Track the iteration number for logging (1st cycle, 2nd cycle, etc.)

read: memory.json (replies.posted, replies.failed, fixPlan.stats, activeThreads from current iteration)

bestPractices: Summarize what was accomplished in this iteration before presenting the decision
Make the options clear and actionable — the user may be returning after hours/days away
Track iteration count to provide context (e.g., 'This was iteration 2 of the fix cycle')
If previous iterations had failures, mention them in the summary

substeps.name: Summarize Current Iteration
substeps.description: Recap what was done in this fix cycle
actions: Read from memory: fixPlan.stats, replies.posted, replies.failed, activeThreads
Calculate iteration number (check if reviewerResponse.iteration exists in memory, increment by 1)
Build summary: comments addressed (by category), replies posted/failed, files modified
Log: 'Iteration {n} complete: {valid} fixed, {partial} partially addressed, {disagree} disagreed, {posted} replies posted'

substeps.name: Present Decision Checkpoint
substeps.description: Pause the process and wait for user decision
actions: Present the iteration summary to the user
- 'New comments arrived' → loop back to Step 1 (Fetch PR and Comments) for another cycle
- 'PR approved / no more comments' → proceed to Step 6 (Continuous Improvement) and exit the fix loop
The process PAUSES here — the template's approvalRequired: true and loopBackTo: 1 handle the mechanics
The user will resume this when they're ready (could be hours or days later)

substeps.name: Record Decision
substeps.description: Store the user's decision in memory
actions: If looping: log 'User indicated new comments — looping back to fetch'
If exiting: log 'User indicated PR is clean — proceeding to continuous improvement'

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for the user interaction?
Verify: Decision was recorded in memory
Output: 'Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Summarize iteration → Present pause-and-resume checkpoint (process PAUSES) → User resumes with decision → Record decision → Compliance check. The template's loopBackTo: 1 handles routing back to Step 1 if the user chooses to loop.

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: fixPlan.stats, replies.posted, replies.failed, activeThreads from current iteration steps
fields: Information Produced: reviewerResponse.decision ('loop' or 'exit'), reviewerResponse.iteration (cycle number)
Decisions Made: User's decision to loop or exit
Notes: Iteration summary, any accumulated failures across iterations
